name: Question 10
problem: Find all of the subsets of $A={0,1}.$
worked_solution:
To find every subset of $A,$ we list out every combination of elements within $A.$ 

We can use the following diagram to visualize the process:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14071627/assets/bb31e2bd632f39706b2785ce6cab764673997fe77b8a9417f7dc213cdff4b7a7.png)

Note that we must include the empty set, since it is a subset of every set.

By doing this, we get

$$
∅,{0},{1},{0,1}.
$$
